image.alt: White two-storey house with a tiled roof under a blue sky

listings.title: Four-bedroom family home with garden
listings.summary: Single-storey home on a walled half-acre with borehole and solar backup.
listings.description: A well-kept single-storey home set back from a quiet road. The living areas open onto a covered veranda and an established garden. Borehole with storage tanks, a 5 kVA solar system and staff quarters are included.

image.alt: White apartment building behind a large green tree

listings.title: Two-bedroom garden apartment
listings.summary: Ground-floor unit in a small secure complex, walking distance to shops.
listings.description: A bright ground-floor apartment with its own small garden in a complex of twelve. Fitted kitchen, built-in cupboards, one covered parking bay and shared borehole water.

image.alt: Bright office with a long meeting table and chairs

listings.title: Office suite with reception and boardroom
listings.summary: First-floor suite with six offices, fibre-ready, eight parking bays.
listings.description: A first-floor office suite in a converted office park. Six enclosed offices, an open-plan area, reception, boardroom and kitchenette. Backup generator serves the whole park.

image.alt: Open grassy plot with trees along the boundary

listings.title: Serviced residential stand
listings.summary: Level 2,000 m² stand on a tarred road with water and power at the boundary.
listings.description: A level, cleared stand in an established suburb. Municipal water and electricity run along the boundary and the road is tarred. Title deeds are available for inspection.

image.alt: Row of white townhouses beside a quiet road

listings.title: Three-bedroom townhouse
listings.summary: Double-storey townhouse in a gated cluster near the university.
listings.description: A modern double-storey townhouse with open-plan living downstairs and three bedrooms upstairs. Small private courtyard, lock-up garage and communal borehole.

image.alt: Swimming pool and timber deck surrounded by trees

listings.title: Five-bedroom house near the river
listings.summary: Thatched home on an acre, sold directly by the owner.
listings.description: A thatched five-bedroom home on a one-acre plot a short drive from the town centre. All bedrooms are en suite or share a bathroom between two. Pool, borehole and mature indigenous trees.

image.alt: White and grey house beside a swimming pool

listings.title: Four-bedroom house with pool
listings.summary: Renovated home on a quiet close with a pool and entertainment area.
listings.description: A renovated four-bedroom home with open-plan living that leads out to a covered patio and pool. New kitchen, borehole, and a cottage that can be let separately.

image.alt: Modern house with glass walls beside a pool

listings.title: Five-bedroom contemporary house
listings.summary: Architect-designed home on an acre with views over the valley.
listings.description: Double-volume living spaces with floor-to-ceiling glass, five en-suite bedrooms and a study. Full solar system, two boreholes and a triple garage.

image.alt: Paved walkway between two apartment buildings

listings.title: One-bedroom apartment near the city
listings.summary: Third-floor apartment with a lift, a short walk from the CBD.
listings.description: A neat one-bedroom apartment in a well-run block. Open-plan lounge and kitchen, balcony, one secure parking bay and a backup water tank.

listings.title: Three-bedroom apartment with balcony
listings.summary: Spacious second-floor unit in a small block with sectional title.
listings.description: Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and a wide balcony overlooking the gardens. Sectional title, lock-up garage and a communal borehole.

image.alt: Two-storey family house with a front lawn

listings.title: Three-bedroom family house
listings.summary: Double-storey house on a large stand with a borehole and garden.
listings.description: A solid family home with three bedrooms upstairs and generous living rooms below. Large garden, borehole, double carport and staff quarters.

image.alt: White and brown house under a blue sky

listings.title: Four-bedroom house close to schools
listings.summary: Character home with high ceilings, walking distance to schools.
listings.description: A well-maintained older home with wooden floors and high ceilings. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms, a separate dining room and a flatlet at the back.

image.alt: Modern lobby with a marble reception desk

listings.title: Full office floor with reception
listings.summary: Whole fourth floor in a managed building with lifts and a generator.
listings.description: A complete floor with a reception area, open-plan space, eight partitioned offices and two meeting rooms. Building has lifts, a generator and basement parking.

image.alt: Green grass field under a cloudy sky

listings.title: Residential stand in a new development
listings.summary: 800 m² serviced stand with roads and water reticulation complete.
listings.description: A level stand in a gated development. Roads, water and sewer reticulation are complete, and power is being connected. Payment terms are available from the developer.

image.alt: Open green field under a blue sky

listings.title: One-acre plot with mountain views
listings.summary: Gently sloping acre in an established suburb, ready to build.
listings.description: A one-acre plot with views towards the mountains. Municipal water and power are available in the road, and title deeds are ready for transfer.

listings.title: Three-bedroom townhouse in a small complex
listings.summary: Modern lock-up-and-go unit, one of six, with its own garden.
listings.description: A modern townhouse with open-plan living, a fitted kitchen and three bedrooms. Private garden, double garage, solar geyser and a shared borehole.

image.alt: Small white and timber cottage under a blue sky

listings.title: Garden cottage with its own entrance
listings.summary: Self-contained cottage on a shared property, water and power included.
listings.description: A one-bedroom cottage with a private entrance and a small veranda. Rent includes borehole water, solar-backed power and garden service.

image.alt: White house with large windows under a blue sky

listings.title: Three-bedroom house with garden
listings.summary: Bright family home on a corner stand in a quiet neighbourhood.
listings.description: A bright three-bedroom home with a modern kitchen and a covered veranda. Corner stand with a mature garden, borehole and a single garage.

profiles.name: Sample Estates
profiles.tagline: Homes for sale and to rent in Harare's northern suburbs.
profiles.about: Sample Estates sells and lets houses, townhouses and apartments in Harare. The team handles viewings, offers and lease paperwork, and keeps every enquiry on record from first message to handover.

profiles.name: Sample Realty
profiles.tagline: Family homes and apartments in Harare and Mutare.
profiles.about: Sample Realty markets family homes, apartments and townhouses. It works with first-time buyers as well as owners moving up, and has an office in Mutare.

profiles.name: Sample Commercial
profiles.tagline: Offices, retail and industrial space to let and for sale.
profiles.about: Sample Commercial lets and sells offices, shops and warehouses in Harare. It advises tenants on space planning and landlords on lease terms.

profiles.name: Sample Land Agents
profiles.tagline: Serviced stands, plots and farms with clean title.
profiles.about: Sample Land Agents specialises in residential stands, plots and agricultural land. Every listing is checked for title, servicing and access before it is advertised.

profiles.name: Sample Homes Bulawayo
profiles.tagline: Houses for sale and to rent across Bulawayo.
profiles.about: Sample Homes Bulawayo is a local agency covering the city's established suburbs. It manages sales and rentals and knows the schools, roads and water situation street by street.

profiles.name: Rudo Moyo
profiles.tagline: Leads the sales team at Sample Estates.
profiles.about: Rudo runs Sample Estates and oversees every sale and lease the agency handles. She has worked in Harare residential property for more than fifteen years.

profiles.name: Tendai Ncube
profiles.tagline: Houses and apartments in Borrowdale, Avondale and Mount Pleasant.
profiles.about: Tendai handles both sales and rentals and is usually the person showing you around. He answers enquiries the same day.

profiles.name: Chipo Dube
profiles.tagline: Family homes, apartments and cottages in Harare.
profiles.about: Chipo works with families looking for their next home and with tenants looking for cottages and apartments close to work.

profiles.name: Tatenda Mutasa
profiles.tagline: Homes in Harare's eastern suburbs and in Mutare.
profiles.about: Tatenda founded Sample Realty and still handles listings personally, from contemporary homes in Glen Lorne to family houses in Mutare.

profiles.name: Farai Chikwanha
profiles.tagline: Office space in and around the Harare CBD.
profiles.about: Farai matches businesses with office space and negotiates lease terms for both tenants and landlords.

profiles.name: Nomsa Sibanda
profiles.tagline: Stands and plots in Bulawayo, Ruwa and Mutare.

profiles.name: Sipho Nkomo
profiles.tagline: Family houses for sale and to rent in Bulawayo.
profiles.about: Sipho has lived in Bulawayo all his life and sells and lets houses in its older suburbs.

profiles.name: Sample Developments

profiles.name: Sample Urban Builders

profiles.name: Sample Heights
